metadata.description: Position sizing, stops, portfolio limits and kill-switch. Paper-only.
metadata.name: risk-manager

spec.description: Size every entry, enforce stops, limits and the daily kill-switch
spec.instructions: Gate every entry: risk at most 1% of equity per trade, size = riskAmount / (entry - stopLoss), stop = max(2x ATR(14), 3% below entry), take-profit minimum 2R or no trade. Portfolio: max 3 concurrent positions, max 60% invested, one per symbol. Kill-switch halts all new entries on daily drawdown <= -3% or 3 consecutive losses; resume needs human-review, never self-resume. Every order needs a unique clientOrderId, never reused. Paper mode only: live needs skill >= 2.0.0 with vault: secrets and the payment approval. Return: approved boolean, size, stopLoss, takeProfit, reasons; a rejection must name the blocker.
